description: This file is a JavaScript source file implementing an image upload, preview, and resize plugin for the jQuery File Upload library. It extends the functionality with image processing features such as loading images, resizing, cropping, and metadata handling for images in upload workflows.

classes.name: blueimp.fileupload
classes.description: An extension of the jQuery File Upload widget to support image preview and resize via the load-image library.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image file and creates an image element, validates file size/type.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Resizes a loaded image according to specified options like max width/height, crop, orientation.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Converts a canvas to a Blob and updates the file list with the resized image Blob.

methods.name: saveImageMetaData
methods.description: Saves image metadata into the image Blob.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the processed image as a preview within the data object.

methods.name: deleteImageReferences
methods.description: Deletes temporary image data references after processing.
